resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com date the cab's move one mile southeast to 1953; the Oregon Lookouts page dates the new tower on that site to 1952. The story gives both dates and does not pick one.

The Oregon Lookouts page gives 40 ft in one quote and 41 ft in another; the register notes USGS data suggests a possible 52 ft. The record keeps 12.2 m (40 ft), and the story mentions the 52 ft figure without adopting it.

notes_for_editor: Brief's coordinates (43.81102, -122.20839) and 5,470 ft elevation match the register. Sources disagree on the relocation year (1952 vs 1953) and height (40, 41 or 52 ft). The Oregon Lookouts page also has a separate 'Mule Mountain #1' entry, which was not checked. No source describes current condition or access; the brief's access 'unknown' is left out. No photo found beyond the register's 1961 caption.
